name: skillbridge
description: SkillBridge — jobs marketplace with quotes, chat and mentors (Phase 2)

scripts.install:all: cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web-react && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && npm run typecheck && cd ../web-react && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy:web: cd apps/web-react && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name skillbridge
